### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #20231 

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed: Add cache for point get

How it Works: move same query from tikv-side to tidb-side

    - Consumes more MEM

issue_context.title: [hptc sysbench-Oltp_Point_Select] Support point select from cache in tidb-side
issue_context.body:
## Description

Point select is a simple query, but every point select will communicate with TiKV. We can cache the same result for next query and it will improve query speed. Refer issue：#17469 

Here's a rough plan:
- When the DML owner only receives `SELECT`, DDL can lock table for keep data consistency then cache the first result for next query.

## SIG slack channel

You can join #sig-transaction on slack in your spare time to discuss and get help with mentors or others.

## Score

- 6600

## Mentor

- @jackysp
